SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\n/// @dev Defines the two fundamental bitmasks used by `EnhancedAccessControl`'s nybble-packed role system.\n///\n/// `ALL_ROLES`: a mask with bit 0 of every nybble set (`0x1111...`), representing one unit in\n/// each of the 64 role slots (32 regular + 32 admin). Used for validation (checking no bits\n/// outside valid positions are set) and for revoking all roles.\n///\n/// `ADMIN_ROLES`: same pattern but only in the upper 128 bits (`0x1111...0000...`), masking\n/// just the 32 admin role slots. Used to extract which admin roles an account holds.\n///\nlibrary EACBaseRolesLib {\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Constants\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @dev Mask with bit 0 set in every nybble \u2014 represents one unit per role slot across all 64 slots.\n    uint256 internal constant ALL_ROLES =\n        0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111;\n\n    /// @dev Mask selecting only the 32 admin role nybbles (upper 128 bits).\n    uint256 internal constant ADMIN_ROLES =\n        0x1111111111111111111111111111111100000000000000000000000000000000;\n\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Implementation\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @dev Regular roles are discarded and admin roles imply their corresponding regular roles.\n    function withAdminRolesApplied(uint256 roleBitmap) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        roleBitmap >>= 128;\n        return (roleBitmap << 128) | roleBitmap;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Derive roles bitmap from assignee counts.\n    /// @param counts Packed role counts (0-15) as `uint4x64`.\n    /// @return Roles bitmap corresponding to role counts > 0.\n    function fromCounts(uint256 counts) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        return (counts | (counts >> 1) | (counts >> 2) | (counts >> 3)) & ALL_ROLES;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Checks if the given value has any zero nybbles.\n    /// @param value The value to check.\n    /// @return `true` if the value has any zero nybbles, `false` otherwise.\n    function hasZeroNybbles(uint256 value) internal pure returns (bool) {\n        // Algorithm source: https://graphics.stanford.edu/~seander/bithacks.html#ZeroInWord\n        uint256 zeroNybbles;\n        unchecked {\n            zeroNybbles =\n                (value - 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111) &\n                ~value &\n                0x8888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888;\n        }\n        return zeroNybbles != 0;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x7e80391029bfec74b4fd9ff9fe7e68b0ec5fdc9d1e439c84dc9572fd6416424b","license":"MIT"},"project/src/resolver/AbstractRecordResolver.sol":{"content":"// \"@ens/contracts/utils/IERC7996.sol\";\nimport {NameCoder} from \"@ens/contracts/utils/NameCoder.sol\";\nimport {ERC165} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/introspection/ERC165.sol\";\nimport Abstract resolver implementation that supports multicall and the standardized resolver profiles.\nabstract contract AbstractRecordResolver is ERC165, IRecordResolver, IERC7996 {\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Types\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    struct Record {\n        bytes contenthash;\n        string name;\n        mapping(uint256 coinType => bytes addressBytes) addresses;\n        mapping(string key => string value) texts;\n        mapping(string key => bytes value) datas;\n        mapping(uint256 contentType => bytes value) abis;\n        mapping(bytes4 interfaceId => address implementer) interfaces;\n    }\n\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Initialization\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @inheritdoc ERC165\n    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override returns (bool) {\n        return\n            interfaceId == type(IExtendedResolver).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IERC7996).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IMulticallable).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IABISetter).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IAddressSetter).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IContenthashSetter).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IDataSetter).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(IInterfaceSetter).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(INameSetter).interfaceId ||\n            interfaceId == type(ITextSetter).interfaceId ||\n            super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IERC7996\n    function supportsFeature(bytes4 feature) external pure returns (bool) {\n        return ResolverFeatures.RESOLVE_MULTICALL == feature;\n    }\n\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Implementation\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @notice Same as `multicall()`.\n    /// @param {node} Ignored, for interface compatibility.\n    /// @param calls The calls to make.\n    /// @return results The results of the calls.\n    function multicallWithNodeCheck(\n        bytes32 /*node*/,\n        bytes[] calldata calls\n    )\n        external\n        returns (bytes[] memory)\n    {\n        return multicall(calls);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IMulticallable\n    /// @notice Perform multiple write operations.\n    /// @dev Reverts with first error.\n    /// @param calls The calls to make.\n    /// @return results The results of the calls.\n    function multicall(bytes[] calldata calls) public returns (bytes[] memory results) {\n        results = new bytes[](calls.length);\n        for (uint256 i; i < calls.length; ++i) {\n            (bool ok, bytes memory v) = address(this).delegatecall(calls[i]);\n            if (!ok) {\n                assembly {\n                    revert(add(v, 32), mload(v)) // propagate the first error\n                }\n            }\n            results[i] = v;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IExtendedResolver\n    /// @dev The first argument of data (`bytes32 node`) is ignored.\n    function resolve(bytes calldata name, bytes calldata data) public view returns (bytes memory) {\n        bytes4 selector = bytes4(data);\n        if (selector == IMulticallable.multicall.selector) {\n            bytes[] memory m = abi.decode(data[4:], (bytes[]));\n            for (uint256 i; i < m.length; ++i) {\n                try this.resolve(name, m[i]) returns (bytes memory v) {\n                    m[i] = v;\n                } catch (bytes memory v) {\n                    m[i] = v;\n                }\n            }\n            return abi.encode(m); // bytes[]\n        }\n        Record storage r = _record(NameCoder.namehash(name, 0));\n        if (selector == IAddrResolver.addr.selector) {\n            return abi.encode(_getAddr(r)); // address\n        } else if (selector == IAddressResolver.addr.selector) {\n            (, uint256 coinType) = abi.decode(data[4:], (bytes32, uint256));\n            return abi.encode(_getAddress(r, coinType)); // bytes\n        } else if (selector == ITextResolver.text.selector) {\n            (, string memory key) = abi.decode(data[4:], (bytes32, string));\n            return abi.encode(r.texts[key]); // string\n        } else if (selector == IDataResolver.data.selector) {\n            (, string memory key) = abi.decode(data[4:], (bytes32, string));\n            return abi.encode(r.datas[key]); // bytes\n        } else if (selector == INameResolver.name.selector) {\n            return abi.encode(r.name); // string\n        } else if (selector == IContentHashResolver.contenthash.selector) {\n            return abi.encode(r.contenthash); // bytes\n        } else if (selector == IHasAddressResolver.hasAddr.selector) {\n            (, uint256 coinType) = abi.decode(data[4:], (bytes32, uint256));\n            return abi.encode(r.addresses[coinType].length > 0); // boolean\n        } else if (selector == IABIResolver.ABI.selector) {\n            (, uint256 contentTypes) = abi.decode(data[4:], (bytes32, uint256));\n            (uint256 contentType, bytes memory value) = _getABI(r, contentTypes);\n            return abi.encode(contentType, value); // (uint256, bytes)\n        } else if (selector == IInterfaceResolver.interfaceImplementer.selector) {\n            (, bytes4 interfaceId) = abi.decode(data[4:], (bytes32, bytes4));\n            address implementer = r.interfaces[interfaceId];\n            if (implementer == address(0)) {\n                address pointer = _getAddr(r);\n                if (ERC165Checker.supportsInterface(pointer, interfaceId)) {\n                    implementer = pointer;\n                }\n            }\n            return abi.encode(implementer); // address\n        } else {\n            revert UnsupportedResolverProfile(selector);\n        }\n    }\n\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Internal Functions\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @dev Get the active storage record.\n    function _record(bytes32 node) internal view virtual returns (Record storage);\n\n    /// @dev Determine address according to ENSIP-19.\n    function _getAddress(Record storage r, uint256 coinType)\n        internal\n        view\n        returns (bytes storage addressBytes)\n    {\n        addressBytes = r.addresses[coinType];\n        if (addressBytes.length == 0 && ENSIP19.chainFromCoinType(coinType) > 0) {\n            addressBytes = r.addresses[COIN_TYPE_DEFAULT];\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Convenience for mainnet address.\n    function _getAddr(Record storage r) internal view returns (address) {\n        return address(bytes20(_getAddress(r, COIN_TYPE_ETH)));\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Find ABI matching contentTypes filter.\n    function _getABI(Record storage r, uint256 contentTypes)\n        internal\n        view\n        returns (uint256 contentType, bytes memory value)\n    {\n        for (contentType = 1; contentType > 0 && contentType <= contentTypes; contentType <<= 1) {\n            if ((contentType & contentTypes) != 0) {\n                value = r.abis[contentType];\n                if (value.length > 0) {\n                    return (contentType, value);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return (0, \"\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev If `coinType` is EVM, ensure it is the proper size.\n    function _checkAddress(uint256 coinType, bytes calldata addressBytes) internal pure {\n        if (\n            addressBytes.length != 0 && addressBytes.length != 20 && ENSIP19.isEVMCoinType(coinType)\n        ) {\n            revert InvalidEVMAddress(addressBytes);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Ensure `contentType` is a single bit.\n    function _checkContentType(uint256 contentType) internal pure {\n        if (contentType == 0 || (contentType - 1) & contentType != 0) {\n            revert InvalidContentType(contentType);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xbe0d1a0eb75449da80c089c128c1605fb39526408f62d863c62665c6fdad410d","license":"MIT"},"project/src/resolver/PermissionedResolver.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: {IEnhancedAccessControl} from \"../access-control/interfaces/IEnhancedAccessControl.sol\";\nimport {IContractNamer} from \"../reverse-registrar/interfaces/IContractNamer.sol\";\n\nimport {AbstractRecordResolver} from \"./AbstractRecordResolver.sol\";\nimport {IPermissionedResolver} from \"./interfaces/IPermissionedResolver.sol\";\nimport {\n    IPermissionedResolverInitializable,\n    Grant\n} from \"./interfaces/IPermissionedResolverInitializable.sol\";\nimport {IABISetter} from \"./interfaces/setters/IABISetter.sol\";\nimport {IAddressSetter} from {ITextSetter} from \"./interfaces/setters/ITextSetter.sol\";\nimport {PermissionedResolverLib} from \"./libraries/PermissionedResolverLib.sol\";\n\n/// @notice An upgradeable resolver that supports many profiles, multiple names, linked records, and fine-grained permissions.\n///\n/// Supported profiles and standards:\n///\n/// | ENSIP | EIP  | Signature                           |\n/// | ----- | ---- | ----------------------------------- |\n/// | 1     | 137  | `addr()`                            |\n/// | 3     | 181  | `name()`                            |\n/// | 4     | 205  | `ABI(contentTypes)`                 |\n/// | 5     | 634  | `text(key)`                         |\n/// | 7     | 1577 | `contenthash()`                     |\n/// | 8     |      | `interfaceImplementer(interfaceId)` |\n/// | 9     | 2304 | `addr(coinType)`                    |\n/// | 19    |      | `addr(default)`                     |\n/// | 24    |      | `data(key)`                         |\n/// | TBD   |      | `hasAddr(coinType)`                 |\n///\n/// Records are created automatically by setters and assigned record ID numbers (starting at 1).\n///\n/// `getRecordId(node)` reveals the internal record ID.\n///\n/// `linkToNode(name, node)` makes `name` use the record currently used by `node`.\n/// `linkToRecord(name, recordId)` makes `name` use a specific record ID.\n/// `linkToRecord(name, 0)` unlinks `name` from the record.\n///\n/// To link, `ROLE_LINK` is required on root.\n///\n/// Names without a record use the default record, which can be managed using the root name (`0x00`).\n///\n/// Every record setter has a corresponding role:\n///\n/// | Function           | Role                   | Argument              |\n/// | ------------------ | ---------------------- | --------------------- |\n/// | `setABI()`         | `ROLE_SET_ABI`         | `uint256 contentType` |\n/// | `setAddress()`     | `ROLE_SET_ADDRESS`     | `uint256 coinType`    |\n/// | `setContenthash()` | `ROLE_SET_CONTENTHASH` |                       |\n/// | `setData()`        | `ROLE_SET_DATA`        | `string key`          |\n/// | `setInterface()`   | `ROLE_SET_INTERFACE`   | `bytes4 interfaceId`  |\n/// | `setName()`        | `ROLE_SET_NAME`        |                       |\n/// | `setText()`        | `ROLE_SET_TEXT`        | `string key`          |\n///\n/// Every record setter has the form: `f(name, ...)`\n/// Some record setters have the form: `f(name, <argument>, ...)`\n///\n/// `grantSetterRoles(setter, account)` gives argument-specific permission.\n///\n/// Every setter with an argument can be decoded with `decodeSetter(setter)`.\n/// Every argument can be translated to a resource with `PermissionedResolverLib.resource(<argument>)`.\n///\n/// eg. `setText(<name>, \"key\", <value>)` will check the following resources for `ROLE_SET_TEXT` permission:\n/// 1. `PermissionedResolverLib.resource(\"key\")` => only \"key\"\n/// 2. `ROOT_RESOURCE` => any key\n///\ncontract PermissionedResolver is\n    IPermissionedResolver,\n    IPermissionedResolverInitializable,\n    AbstractRecordResolver,\n    EnhancedAccessControl,\n    IContractNamer,\n    UUPSUpgradeable,\n    IProxyAuthorization\n{\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Storage\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @dev Number of records created.\n    uint256 internal _recordCount;\n\n    /// @dev Mapping from `node` to `recordId`.\n    mapping(bytes32 node => uint256 recordId) internal _recordIds;\n\n    /// @dev Mapping from `recordId` to `Record`.\n    mapping(uint256 recordId => Record record) internal _records;\n\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Initialization\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @param namer The implementation namer.\n    constructor(address namer) {\n        emit ResolverCreated();\n        _grantRoles(\n            ROOT_RESOURCE,\n            PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_CAN_NAME | PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_CAN_NAME_ADMIN,\n            namer,\n            false\n        );\n        _disableInitializers();\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPermissionedResolverInitializable\n    function initialize(Grant[] calldata grants, bytes[] calldata calls) external initializer {\n        __UUPSUpgradeable_init();\n        emit ResolverCreated();\n        for (uint256 i; i < grants.length; ++i) {\n            _grantRoles(ROOT_RESOURCE, grants[i].roleBitmap, grants[i].account, false);\n        }\n        multicall(calls);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc AbstractRecordResolver\n    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId)\n        public\n        view\n        virtual\n        override(AbstractRecordResolver, EnhancedAccessControl)\n        returns (bool)\n    {\n        return\n            type(IPermissionedResolver).interfaceId == interfaceId ||\n            type(UUPSUpgradeable).interfaceId == interfaceId ||\n            type(IProxyAuthorization).interfaceId == interfaceId ||\n            type(IContractNamer).interfaceId == interfaceId ||\n            type(IPermissionedResolverInitializable).interfaceId == interfaceId ||\n            super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);\n    }\n\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n    // Implementation\n    ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IABISetter\n    function setABI(bytes calldata name, uint256 contentType, bytes calldata data)\n        external\n        onlyRoles(\n            PermissionedResolverLib.resource(contentType),\n            PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_SET_ABI\n        )\n    {\n        _checkContentType(contentType);\n        uint256 recordId = _ensureRecord(name);\n        _records[recordId].abis[contentType] = data;\n        emit ABIUpdated(recordId, contentType);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IAddressSetter\n    function setAddress(bytes calldata name, uint256 coinType, bytes calldata addressBytes)\n        external\n        onlyRoles(\n            PermissionedResolverLib.resource(coinType),\n            PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_SET_ADDRESS\n        )\n    {\n        _checkAddress(coinType, addressBytes);\n        uint256 recordId = _ensureRecord(name);\n        _records[recordId].addresses[coinType] = addressBytes;\n        emit AddressUpdated(recordId, coinType, addressBytes);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IContenthashSetter\n    function setContenthash(bytes calldata name, bytes calldata hash)\n        external\n        onlyRootRoles(PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_SET_CONTENTHASH)\n    {\n        uint256 recordId = _ensureRecord(name);\n        _records[recordId].contenthash = hash;\n        emit ContenthashUpdated(recordId, hash);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IDataSetter\n    function setData(bytes calldata name, string calldata key, bytes calldata value)\n        external\n        onlyRoles(PermissionedResolverLib.resource(key), PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_SET_DATA)\n    {\n        uint256 recordId = _ensureRecord(name);\n        _records[recordId].datas[key] = value;\n        emit DataUpdated(recordId, key, key, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IInterfaceSetter\n    function setInterface(bytes calldata name, bytes4 interfaceId, address implementer)\n        external\n        onlyRoles(\n            PermissionedResolverLib.resource(interfaceId),\n            PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_SET_INTERFACE\n        )\n    {\n        uint256 recordId = _ensureRecord(name);\n        _records[recordId].interfaces[interfaceId] = implementer;\n        emit InterfaceUpdated(recordId, interfaceId, implementer);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc INameSetter\n    function setName(bytes calldata name, string calldata primaryName)\n        external\n        onlyRootRoles(PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_SET_NAME)\n    {\n        uint256 recordId = _ensureRecord(name);\n        _records[recordId].name = primaryName;\n        emit NameUpdated(recordId, primaryName);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc ITextSetter\n    function setText(bytes calldata name, string calldata key, string calldata value)\n        external\n        onlyRoles(PermissionedResolverLib.resource(key), PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_SET_TEXT)\n    {\n        uint256 recordId = _ensureRecord(name);\n        _records[recordId].texts[key] = value;\n        emit TextUpdated(recordId, key, key, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPermissionedResolver\n    function linkToNode(bytes calldata sourceName, bytes32 targetNode)\n        external\n        onlyRootRoles(PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_LINK)\n    {\n        uint256 recordId = _recordIds[targetNode];\n        if (recordId == 0) {\n            revert InvalidRecord(); // prevent linking unknown targets\n        }\n        _link(sourceName, recordId);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPermissionedResolver\n    function linkToRecord(bytes calldata sourceName, uint256 recordId)\n        external\n        onlyRootRoles(PermissionedResolverLib.ROLE_LINK)\n    {\n        if (recordId > _recordCount) {\n            revert InvalidRecord(); // prevent linking future records\n        }\n        _link(sourceName, recordId);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPermissionedResolver\n    function grantSetterRoles(bytes calldata setter, address account) external returns (bool) {\n        (bytes memory arg, uint256 resource, uint256 roleBitmap) = decodeSetter(setter);\n        _checkCanGrantRoles(resource, roleBitmap, msg.sender);\n        if (roleCount(resource) == 0) {\n            emit ResourceArgument(resource, arg);\n        }\n        return _grantRoles(resource, roleBitmap, account, true);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPermissionedResolver\n    function getRecordCount() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _recordCount;\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPermissionedResolver\n    function getRecordId(bytes32 node) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _recordIds[node];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Declares this implementation as an eligible verifiable proxy upgrade target.\n    /// @dev Upgrade authorization is still enforced by the current implementation during the UUPS\n    ///      upgrade call.\n    /// @param {previousImplementation} Ignored.\n    /// @return allowed
